C0629.title: AliExpress Duplicate Listing Cases and Penalty Rules
C0629.summary: AliExpress stipulates that a seller may only list the same product once. Cases show that even if main images differ—such as different angles, packaging status, or colors—listings are deemed duplicate if titles, attributes, and prices are highly similar. Violating listings will be ranked lower in search, and in severe cases, stores may be blocked or accounts frozen.
